notes:
- The profile page keeps as many avatars as you like instead of one file picker. Pick one, press WEAR, and it goes on your account.
- Any size goes in now: 64x64, 128x128, 256x256 and up. Bigger pictures are scaled down to what Minecraft takes, and the picture you imported is kept as it was.
- Every avatar remembers whether it is a Classic or a Slim body, and you can switch that on the card instead of importing it again.
- On Linux and macOS a skin of any size is accepted too, rather than being turned away for not being 64x64.
